checks.description: At a glance identify at least Developer, Web Research, Document Research and QA roles in one populated task graph without opening details.
Distinguish Delegation, Communication, Adversary, QA and Handoff links visually; confirm Adversary and QA cannot be confused.
Click/focus the Communication relation message affordance and verify the correct readable relation board opens and keyboard navigation works.
Observe a mission evolve and confirm only actual agents/relations appear; no speculative future plan nodes are shown.
At 200% zoom and a dense graph, confirm role labels, relation affordances and shell controls remain usable without major overlap.

rule: Human validation may only be marked passed by an actual human execution; QA agents record evidence but do not self-approve Human checks.
